title: SIU investigates after man killed in police standoff near Owen Sound
subtitle: The Special Investigations Unit has been called in following a 24-hour police standoff that ended in a fatal shooting in Grey County.
article: The Special Investigations Unit has been called in following a 24-hour police standoff that ended in a fatal shooting in Grey County.

A man died after an exchange of gunfire with police at a residence on a remote sideroad just south of the hamlet of Mooresburg in Chatsworth Township. Mooresburg is about 40 kilometres south of Owen Sound and 200 kilometres northwest of Toronto.

According to the SIU, the man was shot sometime before 7:30 a.m. on Friday. He suffered a fatal chest wound and was pronounced dead. SIU communications coordinator Monica Hudon would not identify the man but neighbours and friends have confirmed his name as Lou Soles. They say Soles, 52, lived in a rented home on the property.

Grey County OPP officers went to the home at about 6:30 a.m. on Thursday to investigate allegations that threats had been made against someone. The officers were met at the home by a distraught man armed with a weapon, according to the OPP.

Const. Alina Grelik, the Grey County OPP detachment's media relations officer, said she didn't believe the case was a domestic dispute, but she wouldn't elaborate. Although she wouldn't confirm the man's identity, she said he was known to police.

Several neighbours and friends said Soles had been recently released from jail and that he seemed to be on a downward spiral. On Wednesday he tried to get money he believed was owed to him by a former employer. Soles was also trying to cope with the advancing illness of his elderly mother. One friend believes he was overwhelmed by all the stress in his life.
"He just felt alone. No one would help him," said the friend, who did not want to be identified. "He lost it. He snapped. That was not the Lou I knew . . . he would never hurt anybody."

During the standoff Thursday, police cordoned off an area of about 20 square kilometres surrounding Mooresburg. Officers from elsewhere in the detachment responded, as did members of the West Region Emergency Response Team, the Tactics Rescue Unit, the Canine Unit and the Negotiations Unit.
A police helicopter was also seen patrolling the skies for a period of time in the late afternoon amid reports that Soles had fled the home and was on foot.
Police continually narrowed the perimeter starting in the early evening and some officers were seen using all-terrain vehicles to move around the area.

The man, still armed, ended up confined to another building on the same property and police tried to negotiate with him there. His friend said police tried to give him access to a phone so he could call whomever he wanted, but he refused.
The SIU is a civilian law enforcement agency that investigates incidents involving the police that result in death, serious injury or allegations of sexual assault.
